evidence.label: 3 · Short committee paragraph: the three-run comparison
evidence.text:
Input, original OCR:
The Committee on- Appropriations recom- mended non-concurrence.

Expected target reading:
The Committee on Appropriations recommended non-concurrence.

Actual model reading, identical in all three recent runs:
The Committee on Appropriations recommended non-concurrence.

Differences: both damaged word breaks were repaired, the genuine hyphen stayed, and the separate neighbouring sentence was omitted. All three responses passed the reply-format and transport checks, with shutdown confirmed; their request cycles totalled 89.72 seconds. This is the same completed test shown in HR-014, not another run. Those checks do not establish full source fidelity or human acceptance. It is a useful contrast with the longer and more complex scans here.
